entries.12bf6541c3e852d2: As its basic management policy, it sets forth that, based on customer-centered sales activities, it will work on proposing environmentally friendly products and aim to be a global trading company that pleases customers. Its medium-term management strategies are 3: improving earnings, expanding overseas markets, and efforts toward sustainability and establishment of a high-quality system. In improving earnings, it aims to provide high-value-added products through technology-oriented sales centered on technical consultants and fabless manufacturing, and works on an orientation toward fine chemicals and expansion of its sales base in Southeast Asia. In expanding overseas markets, it focuses on sales through overseas bases, centered on Southeast Asia, and handling of imported products.
